summary: Operator site eagle-canyon.com (© 2026) confirms 30/50-amp full-hookup pull-through and back-in sites, 29 RV sites on its park map, cabins, pool, laundry, store, Wi-Fi; phone 308-287-2673 confirmed. Private gate passes: base $40-45 (Campspot read 2026-10-13, matched by RV Life 2026 paid $40/$44), Google 4.5 (202), Good Sam Park 8.5/10/8.5, no long-stay signal beyond a 2020 review. Hookups/sites now manual, facilities added. Website lead: operator site in place of the Campspot page. Not waterfront stands (lake ~0.9 km).
flags: WEBSITE change: https://www.campspot.com/park/eagle-canyon-hideaway -> https://www.eagle-canyon.com/ (the operator's own site; keep Campspot as booking.url if wanted - the operator's /reservations/ page returned a CloudFront 403 so I could not confirm it links to Campspot).

PRIVATE GATE - rate: stored fees $40-45 (Campspot, June 2027, read 2026-10-13) left as is; corroborated by RV Life 2026 paid rates $40 (back-in, Sep 2026) and $44 (back-in, Aug 2026). Higher reports: $50 (Jul 2026, site type not given) and $57 (pull-through, Sep 2026); Good Sam 'From $50 / night'. Base (cheapest fitting site) stays under the $50 gate.
PRIVATE GATE - presence: working operator site + phone; Google 4.5 stars / 202 reviews.

PRIVATE GATE - ratings: Google 4.5 (202); RV Life rating_count 27, no overall score shown on the page (stored 4 stars; the five 2026 reviews read score 10, 6, 6, 10, 6 out of 10); Campendium 3.0 from 1 review (2020, under 25); Good Sam Facility 8.5 / Restrooms 10 / Appeal 8.5. No drop.

PRIVATE GATE - long-stay: passes all five tests (nights sold online and by phone, no posted minimum, no application/lease, not a home community; base under $50). Only signal: an Aug 18, 2020 Campendium review: 'Half the camp sites are taken by locals who pay to keep their camper here all season along with all their toys and junk.' No seasonal offer on the operator site; 2026 RV Life reviews describe a quiet park with 'plenty of room between'. Not judged mostly seasonal.

ACCESS (note-worthy, not a drop): RV Life reviews (2026) warn GPS routing is wrong - one 36-ft fifth wheel following GPS 'got stuck in sand ... and had to get towed', another was sent to a dead end; the correct route ends in ~2 miles of rough gravel ('Listen to the campgrounds directions'). Sand is on a wrong GPS route, not at the campsites: NOT a sand-rule candidate. Consider a note line to follow the park's directions.

SEASON (conflict, not written): Good Sam lists 'Apr 1 - Nov 30'; the stored season (year_round false) rests on Campspot offering no sites for 2026-10-20 or 2027-01-26. Opens/closes left unset because the two disagree about October.
WATERFRONT stands not waterfront: on 2026 Google imagery the RV rows sit in a draw ~0.9 km south of the Lake McConaughy shoreline, behind a tree belt and open slope; no water at the sites.
PIN OK: stored 41.26106,-101.91947 vs Google 41.26101,-101.91970 (~20 m), on the RV rows.
sites.max_rig_ft 30 (derived) left: no operator figure; a 2026 RV Life reviewer stayed with a 36-ft fifth wheel, so 30 may understate.
